subject: general
question: Sachin is 12.5 percent less efficient than Rohit. If Sachin alone can finish a work in 24 days, then in how many days will Rohit alone finish the same work?
solution:
Given:

Sachin is 12.5 percent less efficient than Rohit. If Sachin alone can finish a work in 24 days

Concept used:

Efficiency = (Total work / Total time taken)

Efficiency = work done in a single day 

Calculation:

As we know 12.5 % = 1/8

The efficiency of a person is inversely proportional to the number of days to complete the work.

So the efficiency ratio of Rohit and Sachin is 8:7

Number days to complete the work ratio is 7 : 8

As per the question,

 Value of 8 units = 24

Value of 7 units = (24 /8) × 7

⇒ 21 days 

∴ The correct option is 2
